first_V2_calls.title: catalog
first_V2_calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE transparent PNG lettering original. Exact text "Rätselkatalog" (R ä t s e l k a t a l o g), two umlaut marks. Input images: original user C reference on paper, and newly generated dark V1 catalog; use original C for its handmade drawing attitude, NOT the V1 letterforms. New distinct variant V2 'Werkstattgraphit': broad more upright lively semi-connected hand lettering, slightly blunt angular turns and uneven rounded bowls, alternating character heights and loose spacing, strong dark outlined strokes visibly built from coarse diagonal pencil hatching. Hatching gaps should be large intentional drawn strokes, not noise. Show clearly doubled construction lines and hand-corrected edges. A short oblique crossbar sweep through the lower part of the central lettering, no long ornamental underline looping around the word. Compared with slanted flowing V1, be more upright, open, chunky, independently drawn. Neutral charcoal BLACK and grey only, no brown or sepia. Must look like a skilled person drawing words freehand, not a polished font. Still legible when reduced to 320 px total width. No paper/no white rectangular background, true transparent alpha; no frames, objects, leaves, banners, shadows, labels or extra text. All strokes and umlaut dots fully inside canvas with at least 5 percent transparent edge margins. One line, landscape. Not an approved final asset.

revision.processing: Four built-in generative image edits, two delivered outputs and one unchanged catalogue anchor. G2 and G3 are rejected intermediates, not additional candidates; their hashes are recorded, binary retention is not required. G4 is a generative cleanup, not a pixel-identical deterministic extraction. Final outputs copied byte-for-byte without manual raster retouching, recolouring, cropping, alpha replacement or re-encoding. Static HTML previews display original images proportionally. Pillow used read-only for metrics. No font rasterization. Model/backend version, seed and unexposed parameters unknown.
